items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) : (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n).natDegree ≤ n

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n).natDegree = n

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_mul_X_pow
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R} (n : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) : (p * Polynomial.X ^ n).natDegree = p.natDegree + n
